success.description: 44 You look down upon a battle, it unfolds

boon.description: You can whisper advice to commanders or warriors participating in the battle. Whenever such a character performs an action, you may remove 1 recharge token from this blessing to add {Df} or {De} to that action’s dice pool

bane.description: &8 While this blessing is recharging, you can no longer see with your own eyes or hear with your own ears

conservative.requirements: 6 favour. Targets a battle happening right now within about 100 miles. Specials: If the blessing is successfully invoked, but the target battle is over or has not happened yet, you know this and regain your spent favour. If the battle is over, you know who won. Effect: While this blessing is recharging, you observe the target battle as if you were a keen-eyed eagle flying above it
